topic: Aerogel frozen smoke flower and flame
hook: Your flame cannot burn this flower.
title: A Flame Can't Burn This Flower on Aerogel
description:
Aerogel, nicknamed frozen smoke, is mostly air and is one of the best insulators known. A flower on top stays safe while a flame heats the underside. NASA used aerogel to catch comet dust.

#Shorts #Science #Aerogel
comment_prompt: Would you touch it? Yes or no
